name: kaskade
description: Interactive terminal UI for Kafka with visual topic management, real-time consumer monitoring, and multi-format deserialization - no mouse clicks needed

kaskade.description: Visual Kafka TUI that replaces web UIs - create/delete topics, monitor consumers, filter messages with keyboard-only navigation
kaskade.usage: kaskade admin -b kafka:9092 | kaskade consumer -b kafka:9092 -t user.events --deserializer json | kaskade consumer -b kafka:9092 -t orders.stream --filter key=user123
